question: Find the text of the highest-scoring comment on any post that received a bounty vote of 50 in 2011 and was authored by a user who has also contributed to post history.

arguments.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_008"
FROM comments AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_006" = T2."XCL_026"
INNER JOIN votes AS T3 ON T2."XCL_026" = T3."XCL_067"
INNER JOIN users AS T4 ON T2."XCL_033" = T4."XCL_052"
WHERE T3."XCL_068" = 8
  AND T3."XCL_071" = 50
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T3."XCL_069") = '2011'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM postHistory AS T5
      WHERE T5."XCL_017" = T4."XCL_052"
  )
ORDER BY T1."XCL_007" DESC
LIMIT 1
